# Ink wash — Style Prompt

> Xieyi ink painting on rice paper, painted in front of the viewer: blank paper is space, one loaded brushstroke is a stalk of bamboo, a mountain, a wave or a gesture, ink blooms into mist, and a single vermilion seal closes the picture.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

An ink painting painted and unrolled before you: black ink on warm rice paper in five tones, plus **one** red, the vermilion seal. No outlines drawn around things: forms are made by **loaded brushstrokes** whose dark edge is the contour, by **wet washes** that bleed into the paper, and by **dry, fast strokes** where the paper shows through the bristle tracks ("flying white").

Most of the frame is **empty paper**: sky, mist, water, silence. Things are painted into existence, not cut to. Text is written on that empty paper, never boxed.

Not watercolour (no colour washes), not vector art with a brush texture (no flat fills or closed outlines), not a calligraphy title sequence, not a stock "Asian" template with dragons and lanterns.

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Paper** is procedural, drawn once: warm rice paper, cloud mottling, long fibres, pulp flecks, a light vignette. Painted once at half size and scaled; it never moves.
- **Ink** is stroke opacity over the paper, five tones: burnt (~.96) for calligraphy and the sharpest lines, thick (~.82) for contours and the dark edge of loaded strokes, heavy (~.60) for secondary lines, light (~.34) for mountain and body washes, clear (~.16) for far hills and mist.
- **Brushstroke model**: a centreline, a pressure profile (swell in the middle, taper at the ends), and 5-38 **bristles** across the width. Each bristle's ink load falls along the stroke and breaks on long-scale noise; `dry` runs from a solid wet stroke to pure flying white. One side of the stroke is darker, so the stroke carries its own contour.
- **Strokes are painted in slices**: a long stroke is a handful of images revealed one after another, each wiped in the brush's direction, so it appears in drawing order. Seed every stroke by its index and compute breaks along normalised length so flying-white gaps do not crawl.
- **Washes** (hills, mist, a pale disc): soft shapes with a gradient, blurred once, then only faded or moved. Hills dissolve downward into mist; only the nearest range gets moss dots.
- **Water and sound are blank paper**, drawn as faint open ellipses that widen and fade.
- **Seal**: a slightly rotated red square with the letters knocked out in paper colour and an inset border.

## 3. Colour logic

- Ink only: `--teks` is the ink, `--latar` the paper. Ink is drawn in the text colour at the five opacities, so a dark brand gives pale ink on dark paper and the look survives.
- **One red**: `--utama` is the seal (and the small bullet before each inscription, and a hot-iron tip). Never a red wash, never red body text; a short label such as the contact prefix may use `--utama-di-latar`.
- `--aksen` is not used for fills; leave it to the brand. `--latar-2` appears nowhere; the paper carries the scene.
- Values carry depth: far = pale and soft, near = dark and textured. If a frame gets busy, remove ink rather than add tone.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul`: Cormorant Garamond 700 for the title and the numeral, 104-118 px for titles at 1920 wide, up to ~640 px for a single numeral. Letter-spacing +0.02em. No box, no shadow.
- `--font-isi`: Cormorant Garamond 500 italic for **inscriptions**, 40-48 px, at most two lines, placed in empty paper beside the subject. A small red square marks the start of each inscription. Hold at least 1.4 s.
- Text appears as if wet ink spreads into the paper: a soft-edged wipe from the left over 0.5-0.9 s, never a pop or a slide.
- Leave generous width: a brand font may be wider than Cormorant.

## 5. Motion quality

- A stroke crosses its length in 0.3-0.9 s (linear wipe per slice, 6-8 slices); leaves and ticks in 0.12-0.3 s. Stillness before the decisive stroke: hold, then let it cross in a few frames.
- Blots and dots pop with `back.out(2)` over 0.18 s, 0.1 s apart. The seal lands with `power3.in`, scale 1.3 to 1 over 0.2 s, at 95% opacity.
- Hills fade up in 1.1 s each, 0.35 s apart, rising 24 px; mist drifts 170 px over 3.4 s, linear.
- Ink rings: scale 0.2 to 1.35, opacity 0.5 to 0, 1.4 s `power1.out`, 0.38 s apart.
- Handscroll pan: 900 px in 0.75 s `power2.inOut`, then a hold of 1.4 s or more. Camera push-ins are 2-5% over the whole scene, `power1.out`.
- Transitions are a mist band sweeping across while the old painting fades in 0.4 s; never a generic dissolve alone or a wipe.
- The ending is still for at least 2 s.

## 6. Camera grammar

| Move | Expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Locked frame on the paper | The page is the stage; things are painted in | a thing forming; a line being read; a still decision |
| Right-to-left pan (handscroll) | Time and distance as one painting | a process; a history; a journey |
| Vertical tilt (hanging scroll) | Height, stages stacked | seasons; a climb; generations |
| High wide, a tiny mark in blank paper | Smallness, solitude | one maker in a valley; nature's scale |
| Slow push-in on a dark mass | Weight, pressure | an obstacle; a storm; a deadline |
| Hard cut to an extreme close-up | A break in the flow (the style's only hard cut) | a decision; a shock; a memory |
| Push into an ink bloom or mist | Passing between states | memory; a season turning |
| Pull back until a mark joins the whole | The part was inside something larger | a summing-up; irony of scale |

Framing: 60-80% empty paper; dark masses sit low or to one side, text in the empty side.

## 7. Native moves

- **One stroke is everything.** A single loaded stroke paints the subject. *Fits content like:* a product born from one line; a village growing from one road; a channel's mascot in one gesture.
- **Emptiness is matter.** Leaving paper bare is what makes the mark loud. *Fits content like:* a door opening in a wall; a class with one empty seat; a quiet menu of three dishes.
- **The handscroll.** One long painting panned right to left in stages, a caption under each. *Fits content like:* how a craft is made; a supply chain from field to hand; a day in a street.
- **Flying white.** One fast dry stroke across the frame, strongest out of a silence. *Fits content like:* a sprint finish; a decision; a comet across a stat.
- **Ink rings.** Open ellipses widen from a source. *Fits content like:* a sound, a ripple of news, a launch announcement, a bell.
- **The seal.** A red stamp lands last. *Fits content like:* a signed recipe card; a workshop's mark; a course certificate.

## 8. Pitfalls

- Dry brush looks like dashed lines: breaks from long-scale noise and an ink load that drops along the stroke.
- Parallel semi-transparent strokes look like organ pipes: one base mass plus two loaded strokes.
- Uniform noise on the paper shimmers when the scene moves: draw it once, large, and never animate it.
- Animated blur is expensive: blur once at draw time and only move or fade the result.
- Red anywhere but the seal turns the painting into a poster.
- Text in a box or on a card breaks the page: write it on the paper.

# Ink wash: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2.2, medium 3.2, long 4.4.

## hook

- en: pale hills dissolve in mist, one loaded stroke paints the subject into empty paper, the title bleeds in and a red seal lands
- id: bukit pucat larut dalam kabut, satu sapuan kuas melukis subjek di kertas kosong, judul merembes, cap merah jatuh

## problem

- en: a heavy dark mass looms low in the frame, painted in a few wet strokes; the empty paper around it tightens, push-in with a slight shake
- id: massa gelap berat menjulang rendah, dilukis beberapa sapuan basah; kertas kosong di sekitarnya menyempit, kamera mendekat pelan

## fact

- en: a small inscription written in empty paper beside one quick stroke or dot; the stroke is the evidence, the text only names it
- id: tulisan kecil di kertas kosong di samping satu sapuan atau titik; sapuannya buktinya, teks hanya menamainya

## step

- en: a handscroll: stages painted one by one along the paper, the camera panning right to left between them, a caption written under each
- id: gulungan: tahap dilukis satu per satu sepanjang kertas, kamera bergeser kanan ke kiri, keterangan ditulis di bawahnya

## compare

- en: two paintings side by side on one scroll: left pale and sparse, right dark and dense, an inscription under each, no divider
- id: dua lukisan berdampingan di satu gulungan: kiri pucat dan jarang, kanan gelap dan rapat, tulisan di bawah tiap sisi, tanpa pembatas

## number

- en: a flying-white dry stroke crosses first, then one huge numeral bleeds in inside a loose brush circle; small ink dots count the detail
- id: sapuan kering terbang lewat dulu, lalu satu angka raksasa merembes di dalam lingkaran kuas; titik tinta kecil menghitung rinciannya

## proof

- en: locked frame on the paper: the finished painting still, one inscription fades in beside it; the camera only breathes
- id: kamera terkunci di kertas: lukisan jadi diam, satu tulisan muncul di sampingnya; kamera hanya bernapas pelan

## offer

- en: the object painted large and alone on empty paper, its price written in two strokes of text beside it, ink rings spreading from it
- id: benda dilukis besar sendirian di kertas kosong, harganya ditulis di sampingnya, cincin tinta menyebar dari benda itu

## cta

- en: title and contact written on the painting, a brush underline, the red seal stamped last; everything still for 2 s
- id: judul dan kontak ditulis di atas lukisan, garis kuas di bawahnya, cap merah terakhir; semuanya diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: pull back until the mark joins the whole painting; ink rings fade, the seal stays; held 2 s
- id: kamera mundur sampai goresan menyatu dengan seluruh lukisan; cincin tinta memudar, cap tinggal; diam 2 detik

      @font-face { font-family: "Cormorant Garamond"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 500; font-style: italic; }

      <!-- Adegan 1, pembuka: bukit berkabut, satu batang bambu dilukis sekali sapuan, judul merembes. -->

      </div>
      <!-- Adegan 4, ajakan: suling jadi, nada merambat sebagai cincin tinta, kontak dan cap merah. -->
      <div class="isi" id="s4" data-role="cta">
        <div class="t jd tulis" id="h4" style="left: 150px; top: 200px; font-size: 104px">Pesan satu suling.</div>

        <div class="t ink tulis" id="harga" style="left: 156px; top: 520px">Rp85.000 <span class="redup" style="font: italic 500 40px var(--font-isi)">· kirim ke seluruh Indonesia</span></div>
        <div class="t tulis" id="wa" style="left: 156px; top: 615px; font: 700 86px/1 var(--font-judul)"><span class="kunci">Chat</span> 0812-3456-7890</div>
        <div class="t ins redup tulis" id="alamat" style="left: 156px; top: 780px; font-size: 40px">Bengkel Lereng Kabut · Cibodas, Lembang</div>
        <div class="cap" id="cap2" style="left: 905px; top: 590px; height: 150px"><b>SU</b><b>LI</b><b>NG</b></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <script>
      const tl=gsap.timeline({paused:true});
      const $=(id)=>document.getElementById(id),mk=(t)=>document.createElement(t),{sin,cos,min,max,abs,hypot,PI,exp,floor,ceil}=Math;
      const clamp=(v,a=0,b=1)=>(v<a?a:v>b?b:v),lerp=(a,b,u)=>a+(b-a)*u,ss=(u)=>u*u*(3-2*u);
      // PRNG berbiji dan derau 1D: sama di pratinjau dan render.
      const RNG=(seed)=>{let s=(seed*2654435761)>>>0||1;return()=>{s=(s+0x6d2b79f5)>>>0;let t=s;t=Math.imul(t^(t>>>15),t|1);t ^= t+Math.imul(t^(t>>>7),t|61);return((t^(t>>>14))>>>0)/4294967296;};};
      const nz=(x,s=0)=>{const h=(i)=>{const n=sin(i*127.1+s*311.7)*43758.5453;return n-floor(n);},i=floor(x);return lerp(h(i),h(i+1),ss(x-i));};
      // Token → [r,g,b] lewat elemen uji dan kanvas 1×1.
      const uji=document.body.appendChild(mk("i")),px=mk("canvas").getContext("2d",{willReadFrequently:true});
      const C=(n)=>{uji.style.color=`var(--${n})`;px.clearRect(0,0,2,2);px.fillStyle=getComputedStyle(uji).color;px.fillRect(0,0,1,1);return[...px.getImageData(0,0,1,1).data.slice(0,3)];};
      const IK=C("teks"),PA=C("latar"),rgba=(c,a=1)=>`rgba(${c},${a})`,mkc=(w,h)=>Object.assign(mk("canvas"),{width:w,height:h});
      const toImg=(cv,par,x,y,w=cv.width,h=cv.height,q="image/png")=>{const im=Object.assign(new Image(),{decoding:"sync",src:cv["toDataURL"](q,0.88)});Object.assign(im.style,{left:x+"px",top:y+"px",width:w+"px",height:h+"px"});par.appendChild(im);return im;};
      const S={s1:$("s1"),s2:$("s2"),s3:$("s3"),s4:$("s4"),rol:$("rol")};

      // ===== Kertas beras: dibuat sekali (serat, bercak awan, kotoran pulp, vinyet) =====
      function kertas(){
        const cv=mkc(960,540),g=cv.getContext("2d"),R=RNG(7);g.fillStyle=rgba(PA);g.fillRect(0,0,960,540);
        for(let i=0;i<26;i++){const x=R()*960,y=R()*540,r=120+R()*180,gr=g.createRadialGradient(x,y,0,x,y,r);gr.addColorStop(0,i%3?rgba(IK,0.012):"rgba(255,255,255,0.1)");gr.addColorStop(1,"rgba(0,0,0,0)");g.fillStyle=gr;g.fillRect(x-r,y-r,2*r,2*r);}
        g.lineWidth=0.6;for(let i=0;i<420;i++){const x=R()*960,y=R()*540,a=R()*PI,l=20+R()*45;g.strokeStyle=rgba(IK,0.015+R()*0.025);g.beginPath();g.moveTo(x,y);g.quadraticCurveTo(x+cos(a)*l*0.5+R()*10,y+sin(a)*l*0.5+R()*10,x+cos(a)*l,y+sin(a)*l);g.stroke();}
        for(let i=0;i<110;i++){g.fillStyle=rgba(IK,0.08+R()*0.12);g.beginPath();g.arc(R()*960,R()*540,0.5+R()*1,0,6.29);g.fill();}
        const v=g.createRadialGradient(480,270,260,480,270,620);v.addColorStop(0,"rgba(0,0,0,0)");v.addColorStop(1,rgba(IK,0.08));g.fillStyle=v;g.fillRect(0,0,960,540);
        const im=toImg(cv,$("root"),0,0,1920,1080,"image/jpeg");$("root").insertBefore(im,$("root").firstChild);
      }
      kertas();

      // ===== Kuas: port dari mesin kuas sumber (ink.js): garis tengah × profil tekanan × bulu kuas =====
      const vn=(x)=>nz(x,0),RGB=IK.join(",");
      const PROF={even:(s)=>Math.min(1,0.55+(s/0.05)*0.45)*Math.min(1,0.5+((1-s)/0.06)*0.5),lens:(s)=>Math.pow(Math.sin(PI*clamp(s)),0.75),
        brush:(s)=>Math.min(1,0.45+(s/0.1)*0.55)*Math.pow(1-s*0.9,0.45),tip:(s)=>Math.pow(Math.sin(PI*clamp(s*0.96+0.02)),0.6),
        rise:(s)=>Math.min(1,0.12+(s/0.14)*0.88)*Math.min(1,((1-s)/0.08)*0.7+0.3),robe:(s)=>(0.75+0.25*s)*Math.min(1,(s/0.05)*0.5+0.5)*Math.min(1,((1-s)/0.08)*0.7+0.3)};
      PROF.flat=PROF.even;
      function dens(P,per=10){const out=[];for(let i=0;i<P.length-1;i++){const p0=P[max(0,i-1)],p1=P[i],p2=P[i+1],p3=P[min(P.length-1,i+2)];
        for(let k=0;k<per;k++){const t=k/per,t2=t*t,t3=t2*t,f=(a,b,c,d)=>0.5*(2*b+(-a+c)*t+(2*a-5*b+4*c-d)*t2+(-a+3*b-3*c+d)*t3);out.push([f(p0[0],p1[0],p2[0],p3[0]),f(p0[1],p1[1],p2[1],p3[1])]);}}
        out.push(P[P.length-1]);return out;}
      function resample(D,ds){const acc=[0];for(let i=1;i<D.length;i++) acc.push(acc[i-1]+hypot(D[i][0]-D[i-1][0],D[i][1]-D[i-1][1]));
        const L=acc[acc.length-1]||1e-6,n=max(2,min(600,ceil(L/ds)+1)),out=[];let j=0;
        for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const s=(L*i)/(n-1);while(j<D.length-2&&acc[j+1]<s) j++;const u=clamp((s-acc[j])/(acc[j+1]-acc[j]||1e-6));out.push([lerp(D[j][0],D[j+1][0],u),lerp(D[j][1],D[j+1][1],u)]);}
        return{pts:out,len:L};}
      function brush(pts,o){
        const w=o.w??4,seed=o.seed??1,{pts:P,len}=resample(dens(pts),max(0.25,w*0.18)),n=P.length,prof=PROF[o.prof||"brush"],rough=o.rough??0.12,ws=[],nx=[],ny=[];
        for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const s=i/(n-1);ws.push(max(w*0.04,w*prof(s)*(1+rough*(vn(seed*0.013+(s*len)/(w*1.3+1))*2-1))));
          const a=P[max(0,i-1)],b=P[min(n-1,i+1)],dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1],L=hypot(dx,dy)||1;nx.push(-dy/L);ny.push(dx/L);}
        const dry=o.dry??0.25;let ax=0,ay=0;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){ax+=nx[i];ay+=ny[i];}
        const dd=o.darkDir||[-1,-1],side=abs(o.side||1)*Math.sign(ax*dd[0]+ay*dd[1]||1),nb=Math.round(clamp(w*1.1,4,56)),R=RNG(seed),br=[];
        for(let j=0;j<nb;j++){const off=(j+0.5)/nb-0.5+((R()-0.5)*0.6)/nb,edge=abs(off)*2;br.push({off,bw:(w/nb)*(1+R()*1.1),a:0.55+R()*0.45,ph:R()*1000,load:1-dry*(0.15+0.85*edge)*(0.5+R()*0.7),gs:0.5+R()*1.6,end:1-R()*dry*0.35});}
        return{P,n,len,ws,nx,ny,w,tone:o.tone??0.82,dry,br,side,fade:dry*0.55};
      }
      // Gambar satu sapuan penuh: badan tinta (gradien menipis sepanjang sapuan) lalu bulu kuas yang putus (飞白).
      function draw(c,s){
